Attaching the latest roster (subprocessors_roster_v2.xlsx) — includes columns for country, data scope, and access level. Quick notes:

- EdgeFlow Analytics (APAC) — added 2026-10; provides real-time anonymized telemetry and usage analytics. Processing location: Singapore (primary), with read-only replicas in Tokyo for DR.
  - Access: receives pseudonymized telemetry only; no decryption keys or plaintext content. We push aggregated telemetry; their account does not have KMS/HSM access.
- CloudStore (US/EU) — primary storage provider; has access to encrypted tokens and user-provided content under contract; encryption keys are customer-managed via KMS integration (we manage wrap keys).
- ModelOps (US) — model hosting partner; has access to ephemeral plaintext in GPU memory during inference but no persistent storage of input content; logs are redacted by default.

On the KMS/HSM question: Redwood manages encryption at rest for some hosted customers; for customers who opt into customer-managed keys (CMK) we integrate with their KMS. Subprocessors do not get direct access to our HSM; any HSM/KMS operations are performed through our control plane.

I'll also generate a short data flow diagram PDF for the FinServe review.

Summary of the key points you asked about:
1) Cross-border / APAC subprocessors — The only recent APAC addition is EdgeFlow (Singapore/Tokyo) and they process pseudonymized telemetry only. We flag them in the roster column "APAC_flag".
2) Access to raw/unredacted content — Per Rishi's note: our model hosting partner (ModelOps) sees ephemeral plaintext during inference but we do not persist user input on their systems. Storage providers (CloudStore) handle encrypted objects; plaintext access is restricted and logged.
3) KMS/HSM access — Redwood does not grant subprocessors direct access to our HSMs. For customers with CMK, KMS operations are brokered; subprocessors do not hold raw keys.

If FinServe wants the DPA amendment signed, the DocuSign link is here: https://docusign.com/Redwood-FinServe-DPA-20261125 (also attached as a stub). If you'd like a short call to walk through the data flow and controls, we're available tomorrow morning PST.
